content: Uvicorn latest 0.52.4 (requires Python>=3.10); machine has 0.51.0. On Windows, uvicorn --workers uses multiprocessing spawn: child re-imports the app module -> deadlock risk with heavy module-level init, stdin=None AttributeError bugs in _subprocess.py, reloader kills via CTRL_C_EVENT to whole console group. Community/official consensus: on Windows run ONE uvicorn process per instance; scale via multiple separate uvicorn processes behind a load balancer if ever needed. gunicorn is Unix-only and NOT available on Windows. Single-process uvicorn uses ProactorEventLoop on Windows and is fine for a LAN-scale health/status API.
